content.title: Acute Drug Therapy for SVT, Intravenous Administration

drugs.name: Adenosine
drugs.subsequent_or_maintenance_dose: If no result, 12-mg rapid IV bolus; can repeat 12-mg dose 1 time
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
Concomitant use of verapamil or digoxin

drugs.name: Esmolol
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Metoprolol tartrate
drugs.subsequent_or_maintenance_dose: Can repeat 2.5- to 5.0-mg IV bolus in 10 min, up to 3 doses
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Propranolol
drugs.subsequent_or_maintenance_dose: Can repeat 1 mg IV at 2-min intervals, up to 3 doses
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Diltiazem
drugs.subsequent_or_maintenance_dose: Infusion at 5–10 mg/h, up to 15 mg/h
potential_adverse_effects: Worsening HF in patients with pre-existing ventricular dysfunction
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Verapamil
drugs.subsequent_or_maintenance_dose: Additional 10 mg (0.15 mg/kg) 30 min after first dose, then infusion at 0.005 mg/kg/min
potential_adverse_effects: Worsening HF in patients with pre-existing ventricular dysfunction
Pulmonary edema in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
precautions: AV block greater than first degree
